name: team-clocks
title: Team clocks
description: The time for each teammate: name, city and local time as a list or an analog face, with Working or Off hours in words and the offset to you.
docs: people lists the team with a name, a time zone and optionally a city, an image and workHours (start, end and days; the default is 09:00 to 17:00 on weekdays, and an end before the start is a shift through midnight). Each entry shows the local time, the weekday in front of it when it differs from the reader's day ('Tue 08:30'), the offset to the reader after the city ('+6 h', said in full to a screen reader; a long city wraps and the offset is never cut) and 'Working' with a sun or 'Off hours' with a moon, as words. variant is 'list' (one row per person, with their picture or initials) or 'analog' (a card with an SVG face and the digital time beside it as text, in as many columns as the box it sits in has room for, not as many as the screen has: one to a row in a narrow box, then two, then three). hour12 writes 8:30 AM instead of 08:30, and sort='offset' puts the team in order of UTC offset. The clocks tick once a minute, on the minute, and again when a sleeping tab wakes. They wait for the browser's clock before drawing a time, so the server and the browser never disagree, or take now to pin the moment. The reader's zone is read in the browser, or passed as viewerTimeZone.
